THEARCHITECT-ENCHANT.title: Enchant
THEARCHITECT-ENCHANT.description: Apply an Enchantment to a card.
THEARCHITECT-REMOVE_ENCHANTMENTS.title: Remove Enchantments
THEARCHITECT-REMOVE_ENCHANTMENTS.descrip: Remove all Enchantments from a card. This does not refresh or restore them.
THEARCHITECT-REFRESH_ENCHANTMENTS.title: Refresh Enchantments
THEARCHITECT-REFRESH_ENCHANTMENTS.descri: Refresh a card's Enchantments, restoring them to their normal active state.
